00198 void MixUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00199 {
00200     int channel = 0;
00201     
00202     bool shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00203     bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal;   
00204     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00205     float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00206     float* const channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00207     
00208     memcpy(outputSamples, channelSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00209     
00210     channel++;
00211     
00212     int numChannels = inputs->getNumChannels();
00213     
00214     for(/* leave channel value alone */; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00215     {
00216         shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00217         float* const channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00218         
00219         VFP::add(outputSamples, channelSamples, outputSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00220     }   
00221 }

00224 void MixArrayUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00225 {   
00226     bool shouldDeleteLocal;
00227     bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal;   
00228     int numOutputChannels = getNumChannels();
00229     const int arraySize = arrayRef.size();
00230     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00231     
00232     for(int channel = 0; channel < numOutputChannels; channel++)
00233     {
00234         float* const outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();     
00235         memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00236         
00237         for(int arrayIndex = 0; arrayIndex < arraySize; arrayIndex++)
00238         {
00239             shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00240             float* const channelSamples = arrayRef[arrayIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00241             
00242             VFP::add(outputSamples, channelSamples, outputSamples, numSamplesToProcess);            
00243         }
00244     }
00245 }

00248 void MulAddUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00249 {
00250     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00251     float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00252     float* const inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00253     float* const mulSamples = inputs[Mul].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00254     float* const addSamples = inputs[Add].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00255     VFP::muladd(inputSamples, mulSamples, addSamples, outputSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00256 }

00260 void LinLinScalarUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00261 {
00262     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00263     float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00264     const float* const inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00265     const float* const inLowSamples = inputs[InLow].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00266     const float* const inHighSamples = inputs[InHigh].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00267     const float* const outLowSamples = inputs[OutLow].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00268     const float* const outHighSamples = inputs[OutHigh].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00269     
00270     VFP::linlin(inputSamples, 
00271                 inLowSamples, inHighSamples, 
00272                 outLowSamples, outHighSamples, 
00273                 outputSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00274 }
